topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Oh wow, I can’t believe they chose your essay! That’s such a huge deal, you should be so proud. Your words, your thoughts, out there inspiring others? That’s incredible. I remember how much work you put into it, pouring your heart into every sentence. It’s perfect that it’s being used as an example, it’s exactly what you deserved. You’ve got this bright, beautiful future ahead of you, and I just know you’re going to do amazing things. Let’s celebrate, okay? We’ll find a way to make it special, just because.
